# Sets terrain variant for territories not belonging to any de jure duchy's region.
# (This corresponds to black pixels in map_data/GH_dynamic_terrain_regions.png .)
#
# Scope: Any
# VARIANT - one of: default, desert, arctic, wasteland, lich
gh_set_neutral_dynamic_terrain_variant_effect = {
	gh_set_neutral_dynamic_terrain_variant_by_index_effect = {
		VARIANT_INDEX = gh_dynamic_terrain_variant_$VARIANT$
	}
}

# Sets terrain variant for map region outlined by the de jure territory of the scoped title (duchy or above).
#
# Scope:         Title - Duchy or higher ranked title whose de jure territory must switch to another terrain variant
# VARIANT      - one of: default, desert, arctic, wasteland, lich
gh_set_dynamic_terrain_variant_effect = {
	gh_set_dynamic_terrain_variant_by_index_effect = {
		VARIANT_INDEX = gh_dynamic_terrain_variant_$VARIANT$
	}
}

# Sets terrain variant for territories not belonging to any de jure duchy's region.
# (This corresponds to black pixels in map_data/GH_dynamic_terrain_regions.png .)
#
# Scope:         Any
# VARIANT_INDEX: int - one of the constants from ../script_values/gh_dynamic_terrain_variants_values.txt, or an integer 0 to 4 incl.
gh_set_neutral_dynamic_terrain_variant_by_index_effect = {

	gh_extract_bit_from_mask_effect = {
		MASK = $VARIANT_INDEX$
		BIT_INDEX = 0
		SAVE_AS_SCOPE = gh_temp_variant_index_bit_0
	}

	gh_set_automatic_global_mask_bit_effect = {
		MASK_NAME = gh_dynamic_terrain_mask_0
		BIT_INDEX = 0
		BIT_VALUE = scope:gh_temp_variant_index_bit_0
	}

	gh_extract_bit_from_mask_effect = {
		MASK = $VARIANT_INDEX$
		BIT_INDEX = 1
		SAVE_AS_SCOPE = gh_temp_variant_index_bit_1
	}

	gh_set_automatic_global_mask_bit_effect = {
		MASK_NAME = gh_dynamic_terrain_mask_94
		BIT_INDEX = 0
		BIT_VALUE = scope:gh_temp_variant_index_bit_1
	}

	gh_extract_bit_from_mask_effect = {
		MASK = $VARIANT_INDEX$
		BIT_INDEX = 2
		SAVE_AS_SCOPE = gh_temp_variant_index_bit_2
	}

	gh_set_automatic_global_mask_bit_effect = {
		MASK_NAME = gh_dynamic_terrain_mask_188
		BIT_INDEX = 0
		BIT_VALUE = scope:gh_temp_variant_index_bit_2
	}
}

# Sets terrain variant for map region outlined by the de jure territory of the scoped title (duchy or above).
#
# Scope:         Title - Duchy or higher ranked title whose de jure territory must switch to another terrain variant
# VARIANT_INDEX: int   - one of the constants from ../script_values/gh_dynamic_terrain_variants_values.txt, or an integer 0 to 4 incl.

gh_set_dynamic_terrain_variant_by_index_effect = {
	# FIXME: This is a temporary solution to quickly get terrain overrides working via the existing dynamic terrain visuals infrastructure.
	#        Needs to be refactored later to separate gameplay terrain override logic from that of managing terrain visuals.
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				$VARIANT_INDEX$ = gh_dynamic_terrain_variant_wasteland
				$VARIANT_INDEX$ = gh_dynamic_terrain_variant_lich
				$VARIANT_INDEX$ = gh_dynamic_terrain_variant_desert
				$VARIANT_INDEX$ = gh_dynamic_terrain_variant_arctic
			}
		}
		every_in_de_facto_hierarchy = {
			limit = { tier = tier_county }
			every_county_province = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						GH_any_drylands_terrain_trigger = yes
						GH_any_farmlands_terrain_trigger = yes
						GH_any_floodplains_terrain_trigger = yes
						GH_any_forest_terrain_trigger = yes
						GH_any_jungle_terrain_trigger = yes
						GH_any_oasis_terrain_trigger = yes
						GH_any_plains_terrain_trigger = yes
						GH_any_steppe_terrain_trigger = yes
						GH_any_taiga_terrain_trigger = yes
						GH_any_wetlands_terrain_trigger = yes
					}
				}
				set_variable = {
					name = terrain_override
					value = flag:desert_terrain_override
				}
			}
			every_county_province = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						GH_any_mountains_no_desert_terrain_trigger = yes
						GH_any_hills_terrain_trigger = yes
					}
				}
				set_variable = {
					name = terrain_override
					value = flag:desert_mountains_terrain_override
				}
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		every_in_de_facto_hierarchy = {
			limit = { tier = tier_county }
			every_county_province = {
				remove_variable = terrain_override
			}
		}
	}
	# END FIXME

	every_in_de_jure_hierarchy = {
		continue = { tier > tier_duchy }
		limit = { tier = tier_duchy }

		gh_set_dynamic_terrain_variant_impl_effect = {
			VARIANT_INDEX = $VARIANT_INDEX$
		}
	}
}

			gh_set_automatic_global_mask_bit_effect = {
				MASK_NAME = gh_dynamic_terrain_mask_281
				BIT_INDEX = 0
				BIT_VALUE = scope:gh_temp_variant_index_bit_2
			}
		}

		title:d_akkidakoya = {
			gh_set_automatic_global_mask_bit_effect = {
				MASK_NAME = gh_dynamic_terrain_mask_93
				BIT_INDEX = 1
				BIT_VALUE = scope:gh_temp_variant_index_bit_0
			}
			gh_set_automatic_global_mask_bit_effect = {
				MASK_NAME = gh_dynamic_terrain_mask_187
				BIT_INDEX = 1
				BIT_VALUE = scope:gh_temp_variant_index_bit_1
			}
			gh_set_automatic_global_mask_bit_effect = {
				MASK_NAME = gh_dynamic_terrain_mask_281
				BIT_INDEX = 1
				BIT_VALUE = scope:gh_temp_variant_index_bit_2
			}
		}
	}

	set_variable = {
		name = gh_cached_terrain_variant
		value = $VARIANT_INDEX$
	}
}
